headings: Zoom Developer Platform and App Marketplace
paragraphs: Zoom is redefining modern work as a system of action, turning live collaboration into completed results. From entrepreneurs to global enterprises, customers choose Zoom to seamlessly collaborate, communicate, and drive outcomes across meetings, chat, phone, contact center, events, and more — all with the built-in assistance of Zoom AI Companion. Our mission to deliver happiness, grounded in our core value of care, is fundamental to everything we do at Zoom.

Our platform bridges work both inside and outside the organization by integrating AI capabilities across employee collaboration and customer-facing workflows, enabling seamless communication, collaboration, and engagement through Zoom Workplace and Zoom Business Services. Zoom Workplace with AI Companion brings together Zoom's core communication and productivity tools—including Zoom Meetings, Zoom Phone, Zoom Team Chat, Zoom Docs, and Zoom Whiteboard—to support collaboration across organizations of varying sizes. Zoom's Business Services for sales, marketing, and customer experience teams, including Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Revenue Accelerator, and Zoom Events, support customer engagement across the the customer lifecycle. Trust is a cornerstone of the Zoom platform. We equip users with a comprehensive set of tools to make their interactions safe, secure, and private. We believe that strong security should never compromise a great user experience.
Businesses of all sizes and individuals alike choose Zoom over other industry players for several reasons:

•We care for customers at Zoom speed: Zoom puts customers first and is committed to providing a platform and products that people love. Zoom listens to its customers and puts innovation in customers' hands quickly to serve their needs.

•AI-first: Zoom's mission is to deliver an AI-first work platform for human connection. This AI-first approach to Zoom Workplace and Zoom Business Services is designed to empower individuals and teams to free up time and focus on what matters most: engaging, connecting, and delivering creative and insightful work, all within a single unified platform.
•Enterprise readiness: Zoom is built to meet the needs of enterprises, with robust reliability, security, compliance, and privacy capabilities and policies.
•Designed for flexible work: Zoom is a platform designed for flexible communication and today's flexible work needs.
•Zoom just works: Ease of use is a core design principle, along with quality and reliability.
•Cost-effective and value-focused: The total cost of ownership of the Zoom platform, encompassing both employee and customer experiences, is less than that of our competitors.

•Open platform that enables customer choice: The Zoom developer ecosystem enables customers to choose the apps and integrations they prefer. Zoom offers more than 3,100 apps on the Zoom App Marketplace and integrations with key software vendors, such as Microsoft and Google.

We're on a mission to reimagine the way the world communicates and collaborates. Zoom brings employee and customer experiences together into a single, AI-first, open platform that people love to use. Flagship products like Zoom Meetings, Zoom Phone, Zoom Team Chat, and Zoom AI Companion, are among the core products on the platform that are critical to business communication and collaboration needs. We strive to continue building a platform that helps people work smarter, be more engaged with work, and better connect with each other. AI has been core to Zoom's product DNA for many years, grounded in our conviction that AI can make work more human by strengthening collaboration, productivity, and inclusivity.

In fiscal year 2026, Zoom continued to invest in AI, focusing on three key areas: supporting individual productivity, powering better collaboration, and helping customer-facing teams deliver meaningful business value to delight their customers. In September 2023, we launched Zoom AI Companion, our smart assistant that is designed to empower workers to increase productivity, improve team effectiveness, and enhance skills. Additionally, we introduced our federated approach to AI, which enables the use of multiple large language models ("LLMs"), including Zoom's own, to complete each task for users. Zoom's federated approach allows its tech stack to dynamically select from multiple AI models, including those from OpenAI, Anthropic, and NVIDIA, making AI accessible and affordable so that more people can incorporate it in their day-to-day workflows. With these advancements in AI Companion and our broader AI strategy, we believe we're well-positioned as AI technology continues to evolve. We are evolving agentic AI capabilities within AI Companion that will continue to deliver practical value to customers while building on our ambitious vision of AI that truly amplifies human potential for our

customers. In line with our commitment to responsible AI, Zoom does not use customer audio, video, chat, screen sharing, attachments, or other communications (such as poll results, whiteboard, and reactions) to train Zoom's or third-party AI models.

Zoom continues to be at the center of flexible work. Our continued product innovation is laser-focused on supporting a flexible work environment, with new innovations in areas such as document collaboration, hybrid workspaces, and employee communication. Additionally, our employee experience platform, Workvivo, deepens our commitment to creating a platform that is focused on connecting and engaging employees.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Our Industry
Our revenue growth rate has fluctuated in prior periods, and may decline in future periods.
We operate in competitive markets, and we must continue to compete effectively.
Our results have fluctuated and may in the future fluctuate significantly and may not fully reflect the underlying performance of our business.
Our business may be significantly affected by changes in the economy, including any resulting effect on consumer or business spending.
As we increase sales to large organizations, our sales cycles have and could continue to lengthen, and we could experience greater deployment challenges.
We generate revenue from sales of subscriptions to our platform, and any decline in demand for our platform or for communications and collaboration technologies in general would harm our business.
We have incurred net losses in the past, and there are no assurances we will be able to maintain or increase profitability in the future.
We may not be able to respond to rapid technological changes, extend our platform, or develop new features.
The failure to effectively develop and expand our marketing and sales capabilities could harm our ability to increase our customer base and achieve broader market acceptance of our platform.
paragraphs: Investing in our securities involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including the section titled "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" and our consolidated financial statements and related notes, before making a decision to invest in our securities. The risks and uncertainties described below may not be the only ones we face. If any of the risks actually occur, our business could be materially and adversely affected. In that event, the market price of our Class A common stock could decline, and you could lose part or all of your investment.

Our business depends on our ability to attract new customers, retain and upsell additional products and new product categories to existing customers, and upgrade free users to our paid offerings. Any decline in new customers, renewals, or upgrades would harm our business.

Our business depends upon our ability to attract new customers and maintain and expand our relationships with our existing customers, including upselling additional products and new product categories to our existing customers and upgrading users from a free plan to one of our paid offerings.

Our business is subscription based, and customers are not obligated to, and may choose not to, renew their subscriptions after their existing subscriptions expire. Customers may also terminate or reduce the size of their existing subscriptions. As a result, we cannot provide assurance that customers will renew their subscriptions utilizing the same tier of plan, upgrade to a higher-priced tier, or purchase additional products, if they renew at all. Renewals of subscriptions to our platform may decline or fluctuate because of several factors, such as the composition of our customer base dissatisfaction with our products and support, a customer no longer having a need for our products, or a belief that a competitor's product is better, more secure, or less expensive than our products and platform. Renewals are also impacted by reductions in customer information technology spending budgets or a decision by the customer to consolidate their spending budgets on one of our competitor's platforms, both of which are more likely to occur during periods of high inflation or recessionary or uncertain economic environments. We must continually add new customers and licenses to grow our business and to replace customers and licenses who choose not to continue to use our platform. Finally, any decrease in user satisfaction with our products or support would harm our brand, word-of-mouth referrals, and ability to grow.

We encourage customers to purchase additional products and encourage users of our free offering to upgrade to one of our paid offerings by recommending additional features and through in-product prompts and notifications. However, free users may never upgrade to one of our paid offerings. We also seek to expand within organizations by adding new licenses, having workplaces purchase additional products, or expanding the use of our platform into other teams and departments within an organization. If we fail to upsell our customers or upgrade free users to one of our paid offerings or expand the number of licenses within organizations, our business would be harmed.

Our revenue growth has fluctuated in prior periods. You should not rely on the revenue growth of any prior quarterly or annual period as an indication of our future performance. There are no assurances we will be able to sustain our revenue growth in future periods, and our revenue growth rate may remain flat or decline in future periods. Many factors have and may contribute to declines in our growth rate, including higher market penetration, increased competition, macroeconomic conditions, such as inflation, recessionary or uncertain economic environments, fluctuating foreign currency exchange rates, slowing demand for our platform, a lower than anticipated capitalization on growth opportunities, and the maturation of our business, among others. Our growth rate could adversely affect investors' perceptions of our business and the trading price of our Class A common stock could be adversely affected.

paragraphs: You should read the following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations together with the consolidated financial statements and related notes included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. This discussion contains forward-looking statements based upon current expectations that involve risks and uncertainties. Our actual results may differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of various factors, including those discussed in the section titled "Risk Factors" and in other parts of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

Zoom provides the AI-first, open work platform built for human connection and purposefully designed to move conversations to completion. Zoom enables customers to seamlessly collaborate, communicate, and drive outcomes across meetings, chat, phone, contact center, events, and more — all with the built-in assistance of Zoom AI Companion.

We strive to simplify the workday with AI-first tools that drive meaningful team collaboration and customer engagement. Zoom Workplace supports businesses by providing a secure, scalable solution for communication and collaboration. In addition, Zoom is further helping businesses foster stronger customer and employee relationships through Zoom Business Services, which includes Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Revenue Accelerator, as well as Zoom Events, which empowers sales, marketing, and customer experience teams.

AI is core to Zoom's product innovation. During fiscal year 2026, Zoom has continued to invest in AI, expanding its agentic AI skills, agents, and models, focusing on three key areas: supporting individual productivity, powering better collaboration, and helping customer-facing teams get more done, do better work, and strengthen relationships with AI Companion. Our federated approach to AI dynamically leverages multiple Large Language Models ("LLMs") (including those from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta), as well as Small Language Models ("SLMs"), making AI more accessible and affordable so that more people can incorporate it in their day-to-day workflows. In line with our commitment to responsible AI, Zoom does not use customer audio, video, chat, screen sharing, attachments, or other communications-like customer content (such as poll results, whiteboard, and reactions) to train Zoom's or its third-party AI models.

Zoom's platform prioritizes security and privacy, with 20 co-located data centers globally as of January 31, 2026 and robust encryption options. We are committed to delivering high-quality, real-time video, even in low-bandwidth conditions, while safeguarding our customers' data.

Revenue is driven by subscriptions to Zoom Workplace and Zoom Business Services. Our core offerings include Zoom Workplace Pro, Business, and Enterprise bundles, with vertical-specific plans for Education, Healthcare, and Government. We also offer Zoom Phone, with regional and global calling plans, and Zoom Contact Center, providing advanced customer experience solutions designed to meet diverse customer needs.

Our revenue was $4,868.8 million, $4,665.4 million, and $4,527.2 million for the fiscal years ended January 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, respectively, representing year-over-year growth of 4.4% and 3.1%, respectively. We had net income of $1,900.1 million, $1,010.2 million, and $637.5 million for the fiscal years ended January 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, respectively. Net cash provided by operating activities was $1,989.0 million, $1,945.3 million, and $1,598.8 million for the fiscal years ended January 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, respectively.

The macroeconomic environment, including geopolitical and trade uncertainties, changing monetary policy, and ongoing foreign currency exchange rate volatility, has created and may continue to create uncertainty in demand for subscriptions to our open work platform. Although headline inflation in many major economies has moderated compared with prior years and moved closer to central bank targets, cost pressures remain uneven across regions, and uncertainties around interest rates, policy actions, and global growth continue to influence corporate spending patterns. These dynamics, together with shifts in customers' internal priorities, including budget realignment toward digital transformation and AI initiatives, have contributed to elongated sales cycles and continued caution in enterprise spending, potentially affecting customer upsell, downsell, or renewal activity.

We continue to monitor the potential effects of these circumstances as well as the overall global economy and geopolitical landscape on our business and financial results. The implications of macroeconomic conditions on our business, results of operations, and overall financial position, particularly over the long term, remain uncertain.

On July 4, 2025, the One Big Beautiful Bill Act ("OBBBA") was enacted, introducing several significant corporate income tax provisions, including the option to immediately deduct domestic research and development expenses or continue to capitalize and amortize such expenses for tax years beginning after December 31, 2024, the permanent extension of 100% bonus depreciation for qualified property placed in service after January 19, 2025, and modifications to international tax rules

such as future changes to the calculation of Global Intangible Low-Taxed Income (GILTI) and the Foreign-Derived Intangible Income (FDII) deduction. The impacts of OBBBA on our financial statements for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026 were not material; however, OBBBA resulted in a favorable impact on cash taxes and an increase in our effective tax rate. As our business operations or financial results change, or as additional regulations and administrative guidance are issued, we will evaluate any further impacts to our consolidated financial statements.
Refer to "Part I, Item 1A. Risk Factors" of this Annual Report on Form 10-K for further discussions of the potential impacts of the current macroeconomic conditions on our business.

We review the following key business metrics and strategic factors to measure our performance, identify trends, formulate financial projections, and make strategic decisions, including evaluating our ability to grow the number of customers who use Zoom Workplace and Zoom Business Services. Our operating results and growth prospects will depend, in part, on our ability to attract new customers. While we believe there is a significant market opportunity that our platform addresses, it is difficult to predict customer adoption rates or the future growth rate and size of the market for our platform. We will need to continue to invest in sales and marketing in order to address this opportunity by hiring, developing, and retaining talented sales personnel who are able to achieve desired productivity levels in a reasonable period of time.

We focus on growing the number of customers who contribute more than $100,000 of trailing 12 months revenue since it is a measure of our ability to scale with our customers and attract larger organizations to Zoom. Revenue from these customers represented 32.8%, 31.0%, and 29.2% of total revenue for the fiscal years ended January 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, respectively. As of January 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, we had 4,468, 4,088, and 3,810 customers, respectively, that contributed more than $100,000 of trailing 12 months revenue, demonstrating our penetration of larger organizations, including enterprises. These customers are a subset of Enterprise customers, as defined in the following section.

本公司之科技與基礎建設
paragraphs: Zoom 正在重新定義現代工作模式，將即時協作轉化為實際成果。從創業者到全球企業，客戶選擇 Zoom 以實現無縫協作、溝通並驅動成果，跨越會議、即時通訊、電話、客服中心、活動等多種場景 —— 全部都內建 Zoom AI Companion 的協助。我們的使命是提供快樂，以我們的核心價值觀「關懷」為基礎，這是我們在 Zoom 所做一切的根本。

我們的平台透過整合 AI 功能於員工協作與面對客戶的作業流程，橋接組織內外的作業，實現無縫溝通、協作與參與，透過 Zoom Workplace 和 Zoom Business Services。Zoom Workplace 並結合 AI Companion，將 Zoom 的核心溝通與生產力工具 —— 包括 Zoom 會議、Zoom 電話、Zoom 即時通訊、Zoom 文件與 Zoom 白板 —— 統合在一起，以支持不同規模組織的協作。Zoom 的 Business Services 面向銷售、行銷與客戶體驗團隊，包括 Zoom 客服中心、Zoom 收入加速器與 Zoom 活動，支持客戶在整個客戶生命週期中的參與。信任是 Zoom 平台的基石。我們為用戶提供一套完整的工具，使其互動安全、可靠且私密。我們相信強大的安全性應該不會影響卓越的用戶體驗。
各規模企業與個人均選擇 Zoom 而非其他業界競爭者，原因如下：
• 我們以 Zoom 速度關懷客戶：Zoom 將客戶放在首位，致力於提供人們喜愛的平台與產品。Zoom 聽取客戶意見，並迅速將創新交到客戶手中，以服務其需求。
• 以 AI 為先：Zoom 的使命是提供一個以 AI 為先的作業平台，促進人際連結。此以 AI 為先的 Zoom Workplace 與 Zoom Business Services 設計用以賦能個人與團隊，使其能騰出時間與專注力，專注於最重要的事情：互動、連結並交付創意與洞見的工作，全部都在單一統一平台中進行。
• 企業級就緒：Zoom 是為企業所建構，具備強大的可靠性、安全性、合規性與私密性功能與政策。
• 為靈活工作設計：Zoom 是一個為靈活溝通與當前靈活工作需求所設計的平台。
• Zoom 使用起來很簡單：易用性是核心設計原則，同時也包含品質與可靠性。
•節省成本且注重價值：Zoom 平台的總擁有成本，包含員工與客戶的使用體驗，低於我們的競爭對手。
•開放式平台，讓客戶有選擇權：Zoom 開發者生態系統讓客戶可以選擇他們偏好的應用程式與整合功能。Zoom 在 Zoom App Marketplace 提供超過 3,100 個應用程式，並與主要軟體供應商，如 Microsoft 和 Google 進行整合。

我們的使命是重新定義世界溝通與協作的方式。Zoom 將員工與客戶的體驗整合至一個以人工智慧為核心的開放式平台，這個平台深受使用者喜愛。核心產品如 Zoom Meetings、Zoom Phone、Zoom Team Chat 和 Zoom AI Companion，是平台上對企業溝通與協作需求至關重要的產品。我們致力於持續建立一個幫助人們更有效率地工作、更投入工作，並更好地與彼此連接的平台。人工智慧已經是 Zoom 產品的核心 DNA 多年，基於我們相信人工智慧可以讓工作更具人性化，透過強化協作、生產力與包容性。

在 2026 財年，Zoom 繼續投資人工智慧，重點聚焦在三個關鍵領域：支持個人生產力、提升協作效率，以及協助面對客戶的團隊提供有意義的商業價值，以取悅客戶。2023 年 9 月，我們推出了 Zoom AI Companion，這是一個設計用來提升工作者生產力、改善團隊效率並增強技能的智慧助理。此外，我們推出了我們的聯邦式人工智慧方法，這讓用戶可以使用多種大型語言模型（"LLMs"），包括 Zoom 自己的模型，以完成每個任務。Zoom 的聯邦式方法讓其技術架構可以動態地從多種人工智慧模型中選擇，包括來自 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 NVIDIA 的模型，使人工智慧變得更易用且更具成本效益，讓更多人能在日常工作中使用。透過這些在 AI Companion 和我們更廣泛的人工智慧策略上的進展，我們相信我們在人工智慧技術持續演進的過程中，處於一個非常好的位置。我們正在 AI Companion 內發展代理式人工智慧能力，這將持續為客戶帶來實質價值，同時落實我們對 AI 的雄心壯志，即真正放大人類的潛能。
根據我們對負責任人工智慧的承諾，Zoom 不會使用客戶的音訊、視訊、聊天、螢幕分享、附件或其他通訊（例如投票結果、白板和反應）來訓練 Zoom 或第三方人工智慧模型。
Zoom 繼續處於靈活工作的中心。我們持續的產品創新專注於支持靈活的工作環境，並在文件協作、混合工作空間和員工溝通等領域推出新創新。此外，我們的員工體驗平台 Workvivo，深化了我們對建立一個專注於連接和激勵員工的平台的承諾。

paragraphs: 您應閱讀以下對本公司財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，並與本年度10-K表報表中包含的合併財務報表及相關附註一併參考。此討論包含基於當前預期的展望性陳述，這些陳述涉及風險與不確定性。本公司實際結果可能與這些展望性陳述中預期的結果有重大差異，原因包括在「風險因素」部分以及本年度10-K表其他部分所討論的各項因素。
Zoom 提供以人工智慧為首的開放式工作平台，專為人際連結而設計，並有意圖地將對話導向完成。Zoom 讓客戶能無縫協作、溝通並驅動成果，跨越會議、即時通訊、電話、客服中心、活動等多種情境 — 所有功能皆內建 Zoom AI Companion 的協助。

本公司致力於以人工智慧為首的工具簡化工作日，促進有意義的團隊協作與客戶互動。Zoom Workplace 支援企業，提供安全且可擴展的溝通與協作解決方案。此外，Zoom 還協助企業透過 Zoom Business Services 建立更強的客戶與員工關係，包括 Zoom Contact Center、Zoom Revenue Accelerator，以及 Zoom Events，這項服務能賦能銷售、行銷與客戶體驗團隊。

人工智慧是 Zoom 產品創新核心。在財務年度2026年，Zoom 繼續投資於人工智慧，擴展其代理型人工智慧技能、代理程式與模型，聚焦於三個關鍵領域：支援個人生產力、提升協作效率，以及協助面對客戶的團隊完成更多任務、做得更好並強化與客戶的關係，透過 Zoom AI Companion。我們的分散式人工智慧方法動態運用多種大型語言模型（"LLMs"）（包括來自 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Meta 的模型），以及小型語言模型（"SLMs"），使人工智慧更易取得且更具成本效益，讓更多人能在日常工作中運用。
Zoom 平台優先考量安全與隱私，截至2026年1月31日，全球共有20座共置資料中心，並提供強大的加密選項。我們致力於提供高品質的即時視訊，即使在低頻寬條件下也能維持，同時保護客戶的資料。

營業收入由 Zoom Workplace 和 Zoom Business Services 的訂閱產生。我們的核心產品包括 Zoom Workplace Pro、Business 和 Enterprise 組合方案，並提供針對教育、醫療與政府等垂直領域的專屬計畫。我們也提供 Zoom Phone，包含區域與全球通話計畫，以及 Zoom Contact Center，提供先進的客戶體驗解決方案，以符合多樣化的客戶需求。

本公司營業收入為 4,868.8 百萬美元、4,665.4 百萬美元、及 4,527.2 百萬美元，分別為 2026 年 1 月 31 日財務年度、2025 年 1 月 31 日財務年度、及 2024 年 1 月 31 日財務年度之數值，分別成長 4.4% 及 3.1%。本公司淨收入為 1,900.1 百萬美元、1,010.2 百萬美元、及 637.5 百萬美元，分別為 2026 年 1 月 31 日財務年度、2025 年 1 月 31 日財務年度、及 2024 年 1 月 31 日財務年度之數值。本公司營運活動所提供之淨現金為 1,989.0 百萬美元、1,945.3 百萬美元、及 1,598.8 百萬美元，分別為 2026 年 1 月 31 日財務年度、2025 年 1 月 31 日財務年度、及 2024 年 1 月 31 日財務年度之數值。

總體經濟環境，包括地緣政治與貿易不確定性、貨幣政策變動以及持續的外幣匯率波動，已造成並可能繼續造成對我們開放式工作平台訂閱需求的不確定性。雖然許多主要經濟體的 headline 為通貨膨脹已較前幾年有所緩和，並接近央行目標，但成本壓力在各區域仍不均，且利率、政策行動與全球成長的不確定性持續影響企業支出模式。這些動態，加上客戶內部優先事項的變化，包括預算重新配置向數位轉型與人工智慧計畫，已導致銷售週期延長，企業支出持續謹慎，可能影響客戶升級、降級或續約活動。
我們持續監測這些情況對我們業務及財務結果的潛在影響，以及總體經濟與地緣政治環境對我們業務及財務結果的影響。總體經濟條件對我們業務、營運結果及整體財務狀況的影響，特別是在長遠而言，仍然不確定。

2025年7月4日，「One Big Beautiful Bill Act（OBBBA）」被通過，引入若干重要的公司所得稅條款，包括可選擇立即扣除國內研究與發展費用，或繼續資本化並攤銷這些費用，適用於2024年12月31日後開始的稅務年度，100%加速折舊的永久延長，適用於2025年1月19日後置入服務的合格資產，以及對國際稅務規則的修改，例如未來對全球無形低稅收所得（GILTI）計算方式的變更，以及外來衍生無形所得（FDII）扣除額的調整。
OBBBA對我們截至2026年1月31日財務年度的財務報表影響並非重大；然而，OBBBA導致現金稅產生有利影響，並提高我們的有效稅率。當我們的業務運作或財務結果有所變動，或當有額外的規範與行政指引發布時，我們將評估對我們合併財務報表的進一步影響。
請參閱本年度報告10-K表單的「第一部分，項目1A. 風險因素」，以進一步討論目前總體經濟條件對我們業務的潛在影響。

我們審視以下關鍵業務指標與戰略因素，以衡量我們的表現、識別趨勢、制定財務預測並做出戰略決策，包括評估我們增加使用Zoom Workplace與Zoom Business Services客戶數量的能力。我們的營運結果與成長前景，在一定程度上取決於我們吸引新客戶的能力。雖然我們認為我們的平台解決了廣大的市場機會，但預測客戶採用率或我們平台未來成長率與市場規模仍屬困難。我們需要持續投資於銷售與市場推廣，以應對這個機會，透過招聘、培訓與留住具備能力的銷售人員，使其在合理期間內達到預期的生產力水準。

我們著重於增加貢獻超過12個月營收10萬美元的客戶數量，因為這是衡量我們能否與客戶共同擴張與吸引大型機構使用Zoom的指標。這些客戶的營收佔總營收的比例分別為2026年1月31日財務年度的32.8%、2025年的31.0%以及2024年的29.2%。截至2026年1月31日、2025年及2024年，我們分別有4,468、4,088及3,810個客戶，其貢獻超過12個月營收10萬美元，顯示我們在大型機構，包括企業的滲透力。這些客戶是企業客戶的一個子集，如後述部分所定義。

headings: 與本公司業務及產業相關之風險
本公司營業收入成長率在過去期間有所波動，未來期間亦可能下降。
本公司經營於競爭性市場，必須持續有效地競爭。
本公司之營運結果已有所波動，未來亦可能大幅波動，且未必完全反映本公司業務之實際表現。
本公司業務可能受經濟變化之影響，包括對消費者或企業支出之影響。
隨著本公司對大型機構之銷售增加，銷售週期已延長且可能持續延長，本公司可能面臨更大之部署挑戰。
本公司營收來自於平台訂閱服務之銷售，若平台或通訊與協作科技之需求下降，將對本公司業務造成損害。
本公司過去已產生淨虧損，並無保證本公司未來能維持或提高獲利能力。
本公司可能無法回應快速的科技變革、擴充我們的平台或開發新功能。
未能有效發展與擴展我們的行銷與銷售能力，可能影響本公司擴大客戶羣與實現平台更廣泛市場接受度的能力。
paragraphs: 投資本公司的證券涉及高度風險。您應仔細考慮下列所描述的風險與不確定性，並配合本年度報告表10-K中所有其他資訊，包括「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」部分以及我們的合併財務報表與相關附註，再做投資決定。下列所描述的風險與不確定性可能並非我們唯一面臨的風險。若任何風險實際發生，將可能對我們的業務造成重大且不利的影響。在此情況下，本公司A類普通股的市場價格可能下跌，您可能損失部分或全部投資。
我們的業務取決於我們吸引新客戶、保留並增加銷售額至現有客戶，以及向現有客戶銷售新產品類別，並將免費用戶轉為付費方案的能力。若新客戶數量、續約或升級有所減少，將對我們的業務造成傷害。
我們的業務取決於我們吸引新客戶，並維持與擴展與現有客戶的關係，包括向現有客戶銷售新產品類別與增加銷售額，以及將免費用戶轉為我們的付費方案的能力。

我們的業務為訂閱模式，客戶並無義務續訂其訂閱，且可能選擇不續訂。客戶也可能終止或減少現有訂閱的規模。因此，我們無法保證客戶會續訂其訂閱，並使用相同層級的方案，升級至更高價層級，或購買額外產品（若他們選擇續訂的話）。我們平台的訂閱續訂可能因多種因素而減少或波動，例如客戶結構、對我們產品與支援的不滿意、客戶不再需要我們的產品，或認為競爭對手的產品更好、更安全或更便宜。續訂也受到客戶資訊科技支出預算減少，或客戶選擇將支出集中於競爭對手平台的影響，這在高通貨膨脹或經濟衰退或不確定的總體經濟環境中更有可能發生。我們必須持續增加新客戶與授權，以成長業務，並取代選擇不再使用我們平台的客戶與授權。最後，若用戶對我們產品或支援的滿意度下降，將對我們的品牌、口碑推薦與成長能力造成傷害。
我們鼓勵客戶購買額外產品，並透過推薦額外功能與在產品內的提示與通知，鼓勵免費用戶升級至我們的付費方案。然而，免費用戶可能永遠不會升級至我們的付費方案。我們也致力於在組織內擴張，透過增加新授權、讓企業購買額外產品，或將我們的平台擴展至組織內的其他團隊與部門。若我們未能成功向客戶升級銷售或將免費用戶轉為付費方案，或未能擴大組織內的授權數量，將對我們的業務造成傷害。

我們的營收成長在過去期間有所波動。您不應依賴任何過去季度或年度的營收成長作為未來表現的指標。我們無法保證未來能維持營收成長，且未來的營收成長率可能維持平穩或下降。許多因素已導致或可能導致我們成長率下降，包括更高的市場滲透率、增加的競爭、總體經濟條件，如通貨膨脹、經濟衰退或不確定的總體經濟環境、匯率波動、對我們平台需求減緩、對成長機會的資本化低於預期，以及我們業務的成熟，等等。我們的成長率可能對投資者對我們業務的觀感造成不利影響，並可能對本公司A類普通股的交易價格造成不利影響。
